description: Make the SyncPanel environment-aware: filter by selected environment when syncing, show environment badge on items, add 'All Environments' mode. Also modify validation/publish flows to use selected environment's config.
steps: Modify cms/src/plugins/rule-engine/admin/src/components/SyncPanel/index.tsx: import useEnvironment hook, pass selected environment's documentId to the sync status API call as query param (?env=docId or empty for all). Show environment badge on each SyncItem if displaying all environments.
Add optional 'env' query param to GET /sync/status route in server. Modify syncController.syncStatus() to filter CMS queries by environment relation when env param is provided.
Modify syncController to pass environment's config to AdminClient when calling engine APIs (so it syncs against the correct engine deployment).
Create cms/src/plugins/rule-engine/admin/src/hooks/useEnvironmentConfig.ts helper hook that returns the resolved AdminClientConfig for the selected environment (for validation panel usage).
Add environment badge display to SyncPanel items when in 'All Environments' mode: show which env each flow/jdm/connection belongs to.

Add server route POST /environments/:id/validate-flow/:flowId that validates a flow against a specific environment's engine (passes env config to AdminClient). This supports validating a flow against different environments.
Extend environment controller with validateFlow() method.
Update sync.test.ts to cover environment-filtered sync status.
Add integration notes in context about how content-manager edit views (Flow, JDM, Connection) could be extended to show the EnvironmentSelector — that's outside plugin scope but the hooks are ready.
acceptance_criteria: SyncPanel filters by selected environment when one is selected
SyncPanel shows all environments when 'All Environments' is selected
Each sync item shows environment badge when in all-envs mode
Sync operations target the correct engine based on selected environment
Test connection and validation target correct engine per environment
All existing tests pass plus new env-filter tests
